name: SharedWorkspaceFolders
description: A collection of the SharedWorkspaceFolder objects in the current shared workspace.
example:
Dim swsFolders As Office.SharedWorkspaceFolders
    Set swsFolders = ActiveWorkbook.SharedWorkspace.Folders
    MsgBox "There are " & swsFolders.Count & _
        " folder(s) in the current shared workspace.", _
        vbInformation + vbOKOnly, _
        "Collection Information"
    Set swsFolders = Nothing

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SharedWorkspaceFile object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SharedWorkspaceFolders object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a SharedWorkspaceFolder object from the Folders collection of the shared workspace. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the SharedWorkspaceFolders collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the SharedWorkspaceFolders object. Read-only.

properties.name: ItemCountExceeded
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value that indicates whether the number of SharedWorkspaceFolders items in the collection has exceeded the 99 that can be displayed in the Shared Workspace task pane. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(FolderName As String, [ParentFolder As Variant]) As SharedWorkspaceFolder
methods.description: Adds a folder to the document library in a shared workspace. Returns a SharedWorkspaceFolder object.

parameters.name: FolderName
parameters.description: The name of the folder to be added to the current shared workspace.

parameters.name: ParentFolder
parameters.description: The subfolder in which to place the new folder, if not the main document library folder within the shared workspace. Add the folder to the main document library folder by leaving this optional argument empty.
